caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with detailed carvings and a brown finish. The chest consists of an upper cabinet section with three intricately carved rectangular panels, each featuring symmetrical geometric and botanical patterns; the middle panel displays circular motifs, while the side panels feature stylized plant forms with vertical columns separating the panels. Below the upper cabinet are two large drawers, each adorned with decorative hardware and framed in beveled borders with oval-shaped handles. The chest stands on four rectangular legs, and the side panels are also decorated with recessed rectangular shapes and some carved ornamentation. The top surface is flat and the perspective shows the left front and part of the right side. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color.
title: Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
